> BEATPAD is a four-key rhythm game controller. It features illuminated keys, preloaded songs, multiple difficulty modes, and a display for song information and scores. Players follow the lights and press the corresponding keys in sync with the music.

## Design

### 2026-10-25 – The complete 3D model of BEATPAD has been successfully designed and finalised. The model includes the main enclosure, four long playing keys arranged side by side, an upper control panel, a display ar

**15h**

The complete 3D model of BEATPAD has been successfully designed and finalised. The model includes the main enclosure, four long playing keys arranged side by side, an upper control panel, a display area, and three dedicated control buttons for song selection, start/pause, and difficulty modes.

The overall dimensions, proportions, spacing, and placement of the components have been carefully planned to create a compact and functional design. The model also accounts for the space required for the electronic components that will be integrated into the device.

With the entire CAD model now completed, the project is ready to move forward to the electronics design and circuit connections.

### 2026-10-25 – I have successfully gathered all the required electronic components for BEATPAD in Tinkercad and arranged them as part of the circuit design workspace. This includes the Arduino Uno, LCD display, push

**15h**

I have successfully gathered all the required electronic components for BEATPAD in Tinkercad and arranged them as part of the circuit design workspace. This includes the Arduino Uno, LCD display, pushbuttons, RGB LEDs, buzzer, and power supply.

The basic circuit schematic has also been laid out, with all the major components identified and positioned. This provides a clear overview of how the electronics will come together.

The actual wiring and connections between the components are still pending. Once completed, the circuit will form the electronic foundation of BEATPAD, bringing the rhythm game concept closer to a functional prototype.

### 2026-10-25 – The complete 3D CAD model of BEATPAD has been designed and finalised, including the main enclosure, four playing keys, display area, and control panel.

**15h**

The complete 3D CAD model of BEATPAD has been designed and finalised, including the main enclosure, four playing keys, display area, and control panel.

I also completed the electronic component selection and assembled the basic circuit schematic in Tinkercad. The Arduino Uno, I2C LCD, seven pushbuttons, four individual LEDs, buzzer, and power supply have all been incorporated into the circuit design.

The Arduino program has been developed to handle the game's core functionality, including song selection, difficulty modes, gameplay, LED indications, button inputs, buzzer feedback, and score tracking.

With the mechanical design, component arrangement, circuit planning, and initial programming completed, BEATPAD has progressed from an idea into a detailed virtual prototype.
